name: dyn_err_index2
source:
{ Two inertias rigidly coupled: index-2, no algebraic unknown left. }
Tq = 1

DYNAMIC rigid (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 10, points = 3)
  der(W1) = Tq
  der(W2) = Tq
  W1 = W2
  W1(0) = 0
  W2(0) = 0
END

error.message: There are 7 equations and 6 variables. The problem is overspecified and cannot be solved. Redundant relation (no free variable left to determine): w1 = 0.0. A common cause: the same physics stated twice — a boundary pinning a quantity a component already defines (a re-equated mixer pressure, a T-pinned wall state), or two property calls restating one relation.
